title: Recommendations of Rami e Jumraat
introduction:
RECOMMENDATIONS OF RAMI-E-JUMRAAT

Some things are recommended in Rami-e-Jumraat:

1. Being clean while throwing pebbles.

2. I. Sadiq (a) said: "Recite the following supplication when you are ready to throw pebbles:

3. Saying a 'Takbeer' for every pebble thrown.

4. Reciting the following supplication for every pebble thrown:

5. Having a distance of 10 to 15 steps with Big satan while hitting him. Standing near small satans while hitting them.

6. Facing the big Satan and back towards Qiblah while hitting him. Facing Qiblah while hitting small and medium satans.

7. Keeping the pebble on finger-ring and throwing with the nail of the finger of kalemah.

8. Upon reaching the Qiyam in Mina, one should recite this supplication:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهٖ حَصَیَاتِیْ فَاحْصِهِنَّ لِیْ وَ ارْفَعْهُنَّ فِیْ عَمَلِیْ۔

اَﷲُ اَكْبَرُ اَللّٰهُمَّ ادْحَرْ عَنِّیْ الشَّیْطَانَ اَللّٰهُمَّ تَصْدِیْقًا بِكِتَابِكَ وَ عَلٰی سُنَّۃِ نَبِیِّكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لِیْ حَجًّا مَبْرُوْرًا وَ عَمَلًا مَقْبُوْلًا وَ سَعْیًا مَشْكُوْرًا وَ ذَنْبًا مَغْفُوْرًا۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ وَثِقْتُ وَ عَلَیْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَنِعْمَ الرَّبُّ وَ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلٰی وَ نِعْمَ النَّصِیْرُ۔
